description: This file is an Android activity class (SkeletonActivity), demonstrating basic Android UI components and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: SkeletonActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating basic UI interactions and menu handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and sets up UI components.
